## 🛑 Automation stopped: two consecutive AI sessions produced identical results

`--auto-restart-until-mergeable` stopped working on this pull request.

**Reason code:** `no_progress_between_sessions`

**What happened:** Two consecutive AI sessions ended with the same working tree and the same commit although the second one was given different instructions, so another restart cannot produce a different result.

The AI session ended with the same working tree and the same commit as the session before it (its final message is not compared: a reworded report of the same blocker is not progress). Restarting again would repeat the same session at the same cost, so the remaining restart budget was left unused.

**Details:**
- Previous session: Primary session, session `42e9f82e-f152-406a-9d49-45ad6c1e6a1d`, log `/home/box/42e9f82e-f152-406a-9d49-45ad6c1e6a1d.log`
- Identical session: session `6be2f76a-c4fc-4a88-a4a4-d3dc185cbaf3`, log `/home/box/6be2f76a-c4fc-4a88-a4a4-d3dc185cbaf3.log`
- Neither session left anything uncommitted in the working tree.
- Both sessions ended on the same commit: `2ba2553397e8cdaf9adf092cc894533670672861`.
- 5 restart iterations of the configured budget were left unused: another identical session would cost the same and end the same way.
- There were no uncommitted changes left to preserve.

**What to do next:**
- Read the two working session logs named below to see what the AI kept doing.
- Fix the blocker it kept hitting (a missing toolchain, an unreachable service, an impossible instruction), then re-run the command.
- Or re-run with different instructions so the next session has something new to work with.

---
*Reported automatically by hive-mind (auto-restart-until-mergeable).*
